value.rationale: Complete equality-time classification for arbitrary mixed-radix perfect additive complements answers a natural sharpness question left by selected endpoints in recent 2026 study. Exact counts and binary full return times sharpen existence-only results and distinguish sparse equality times from general asymptotic bounds. The mathematical purpose is full classification, not a routine finite search or claim to a new sharp global bound.
